summary: Iteration 49 - Cultural Identity Engine Testing Complete. Backend: 14/14 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 6 new components verified - CulturalIdentityBar, ConstellationRadar, CulturalFeed, CulturalCards, CulturalReactions, MobileNavigation. All features working correctly.

recalculate_score.details: Updates score based on reactions given/received and posts

add_reaction.details: Adds reaction with emoji and label

validate_reaction_type.details: Returns 400 for invalid types, accepts feu/rythme/racines/resistance/lumiere

cultural_identity_bar.notes: Renders with animated score 0→value, level markers (Initié/Ancré/Enraciné/Transmetteur/Pilier), gold gradient fill

constellation_radar.notes: SVG radar chart with 7 dimensions, animated polygon fill, gold accent color

cultural_feed.notes: Infinite scroll feed with filter tabs (Tout/Musique/Artistes/Lieux/Événements/Patrimoine)

cultural_cards.notes: Cards show card_type badge, dimension dot, title, subtitle, description, meta tags, duration for music

cultural_reactions.notes: 5 emoji buttons (🔥🥁🌺✊💫) with counts, burst animation on click

mobile_navigation.notes: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (<768px) with 5 tabs: Feed/Réseau/Créer/Agenda/Moi

skeleton_loading.notes: CardSkeleton shows during feed fetch with pulse animation

pro_login_bypass.notes: Bypass admin email cultureconnectorg@gmail.com with code 000000 works

critical_code_review_comments: All 4 backend APIs implemented correctly with proper validation and MongoDB integration
18 seeded cultural cards cover all 5 types (musique/artiste/lieu/evenement/patrimoine) and 7 dimensions
Reaction toggle logic works correctly - second click removes reaction
CulturalIdentityBar has smooth animation from 0 to score value with IntersectionObserver
ConstellationRadar SVG renders 7-axis radar with animated polygon fill
CulturalFeed implements infinite scroll with IntersectionObserver and pull-to-refresh on mobile
MobileNavigation uses md:hidden breakpoint and fixed positioning at bottom
Design tokens correctly applied: bg=#0a0a0a, gold=#C8A84B, text=#FFFFFF, muted=#888888
All components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Cultural cards seeded via POST /api/cultural-feed/seed (18 cards). Test reactions created during API tests.
